Interface BuildLog

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractBuildLog
public interface BuildLog
用于提供Builder输出日志的回调接口。
Since:
2.3.0
Author:
Phillip Webb，Scott Frederick，Andrey Shlykov，Rafael Ceccone
